---
title: "Cleveland Community Cat Project"
toc: false
---

Cleveland Community Cat Project is an all-volunteer nonprofit dedicated to improving the lives of community cats. Our mission is to reduce suffering through targeted Trap-Neuter-Return, advanced veterinary care, rescue, education, and support for the people on the front lines of community cat welfare. Community cats deserve more than spay/neuter. They deserve veterinary care, compassionate advocates, and a community willing to invest in their welfare. We focus our resources where they can make the greatest difference for the cats who need them most.
